* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云行驶证识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，精准定位和识别行驶证正、副页所包含的关键信息，支持正副页在同一张图片的场景进行自动分割与结构化识别。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |行驶证混贴|支持对正副页在同一张图片的场景进行自动分割与结构化识别。| |高精度识别|总体准确率达93%以上。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [车辆物流识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=vehicle_license#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[行驶证识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0739%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeVehicleLicense?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |国家与语言|
  • 本接口只支持中国行驶证。
| |其他提示|
  • 请保证整张行驶证内容及其边缘包含在图像内。
  • 本能力会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| |相关能力|
  • [行驶证识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi011791.html?spm=5176.730005.result.13.291d3524fc1E2j&innerSource=search_%E8%A1%8C%E9%A9%B6%E8%AF%81#sku=yuncode579100000)
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for this API * Alibaba Cloud Vehicle License Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product that accurately locates and recognizes key information on both the front and back pages of a Chinese vehicle license. It supports automatic segmentation and structured recognition when both pages appear in the same image. * Built on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years to deliver high stability, ease of use, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample images for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Multi-type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurred images, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | Image Enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Mixed Front-and-Back Pages | Automatically segments and structurally recognizes front and back pages when they appear together in a single image. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall accuracy rate of over 93%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Vehicle Logistics Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test this feature’s performance via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=vehicle_license#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Vehicle License Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0739%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing purposes. Alternatively, you may skip purchasing a resource plan, and the system will automatically charge based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeVehicleLicense?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image width and height must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Large images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Country and Language |
  • This API supports only Chinese vehicle licenses.
| | Other Tips |
  • Ensure the entire content of the vehicle license, including its edges, is fully visible within the image.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but such conditions may reduce accuracy. Whenever possible, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images.
| | Related Capabilities |
  • [Vehicle License Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi011791.html?spm=5176.730005.result.13.291d3524fc1E2j&innerSource=search_%E8%A1%8C%E9%A9%B6%E8%AF%81#sku=yuncode579100000).
|
